title: Offline Coordinator identity, lease, revision, and event client contract

operations.claim: open task only; exact revision; unique owner/worktree; creates a lease and increments revision
operations.heartbeat: active matching owner, lease, session, worktree, and revision; extends lease without changing revision
operations.state_event: active matching lease and exact revision; bounded digest-only event; increments revision
operations.release: active matching lease and exact revision; terminal status is Coordinator-validated and increments revision

durability.format: one canonical JSON document with an append-only digest-linked event list
durability.write: write a complete temporary document, flush and fsync it, then atomically replace the supplied file
durability.recovery: malformed JSON, broken chain, duplicate operation, or ambiguous write is rejected; success is never guessed
durability.event_identity: operation_id is single-use; identical replay returns the original result, changed replay fails

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline

privacy.projection: only opaque identifiers, bounded enums, revisions, lease times, and sha256 digests

failure_semantics.external_effects: none: no network, provider, LLM, hosted CI, Git, or durable Coordinator repository mutation

evidence_boundary.offline: fixture and local harness qualification only
evidence_boundary.live: unverified; this AR does not enable a remote Coordinator client
follow_up: Use the project-bound handoffctl/Coordinator client for live state operations after independent security and approval gates.
Add production transport and crash-injection qualification only under a separately approved integration task.
